body:
I've been smoking up for about four years now. Earlier in my dealings with pot I had an extremely odd experience, that may have been laced with an unknown substance. I had been smoking for about a year when I had this experience, so I was a fairly seasoned toker. I went to one of those thirty hour famine things, with the intention of getting really stoned, and did I ever get stoned. The chaparone at the famine was cool with us going out to smoke up, so two friends and I went outside and smoked two one gram joints between us. We were all pretty stoned after that, so we went back inside.
About three hours later there were lots more people, and some guy showed up with seven grams of herb. I helped him to roll it all, and I noticed the bud was slightly shiny, I thought nothing of it at the time, and maybe it was nothing, who knows. Anyway, once it was all rolled we went outside to smoke it, there must have been 11 or 12 people in the circle, and we stood there and smoked all seven grams. I was extremely stoned after, more so than I have ever been, to this date. I had this overwhelming feeling of joy, I couldn't stop smiling. Then weird things started to happen. I felt really tired, and I'd catch myself falling asleep all the time, even while walking. Whenever I fell asleep, I could see myself walking around, like I was hovering behind my body. I could control my movements, but not very well. It was like a video game, I could see myself run into a door frame, and fall over, then get back up, but I didn't feel it. Whenever I went into that state, I had an unstoppable need to walk around very fast. This was alright for a while, but then everyone was going to sleep, so I couldn't walk around anymore. When I couldn't walk, my legs would start convulsing violently. I became paniced, and told people that I had overdosed, and that they needed to call amulance, luckily no one did. I eventually lost consciousness and woke up the next morning pleasantly stoned.
Ever since then my hands have been a bit shakey, and at rare times I have odd twitches. I continued smoking pot and still do, that was the only bad experience I've ever had with it.
